sentences.en: Same mentality, which is kill or be killed.

sentences.zh: 所以，鉴于新闻从业者的工作性质，这种关系确实会发生变化。

sentences.en: So the week before that debate, I had been discussing that with him, but with somebody else, the Michael Cohen statement that you can't rape your wife.
sentences.zh: 在那场辩论的前一周，我曾和他讨论过这件事，但当时还有别人在场，讨论的是迈克尔·科恩关于“你不能强奸你的妻子”的言论。

sentences.en: Michael Cohen had said this in defense of Trump, who had been accused by his first wife, Ivana, of having raped her
sentences.zh: 迈克尔·科恩当时说这话是为了替特朗普辩护，因为特朗普的第一任妻子伊万娜曾指控他强奸了她，

sentences.en: in the course of their first marriage or divorce or in some explosive argument, an allegation she later recanted.
sentences.zh: 那是在他们第一次婚姻或离婚期间，或者是在某次激烈的争吵中，不过她后来撤回了这一指控。

sentences.en: And I was knocking Michael Cohen for the ridiculous assertion that one cannot rape one's wife.
sentences.zh: 我当时在批评迈克尔·科恩，因为他说“一个人不能强奸自己的妻子”，这简直荒谬至极。

sentences.en: Well, he did not like that.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他不喜欢那样。

sentences.en: Trump was watching and he called me up and he told me something to the effect of he didn't want to see any more segments like that on the Kelly file.
sentences.zh: 特朗普当时在看节目，他给我打了电话，大意是说他不想在《凯利档案》节目中再看到类似的片段了。

sentences.en: And I told him he doesn't control the editorial on the Kelly file.
sentences.zh: 我告诉他，他管不了《凯利档案》的编辑方针。

sentences.en: And he screamed at me and hung up on me.
sentences.zh: 他对我大吼大叫，然后挂断了电话。

sentences.en: This is the week before the debate.
sentences.zh: 那是辩论前的一周。

sentences.en: And then he kept calling Fox executives and complaining about me.
sentences.zh: 之后，他不断地给福克斯的高管打电话投诉我。

sentences.en: I think his spidey senses were up that, you know, maybe I'm not in the friend camp anymore and something could happen at this debate that might not be good for him.
sentences.zh: 我想他的直觉很敏锐，他可能觉得我不再是他的“朋友阵营”了，而且在那场辩论中可能会发生对他不利的事情。

sentences.en: And so here's the second thing.
sentences.zh: 所以，这是第二件事。

sentences.en: So in the beginning, I think he was genuinely angry.
sentences.zh: 起初，我想他是真的生气了。

sentences.en: But I think it quickly turned to he liked it as a storyline.
sentences.zh: 但我认为这种情绪很快就转变成了他喜欢这种故事情节。

sentences.en: And he wasn't wrong that it was good for him to show the world and in particular,
sentences.zh: 而且他没想错，向全世界展示这一点对他很有利，尤其是对那些感到被共和党冷落或抛弃的选民来说，

sentences.en: Republican voters who felt disaffected or abandoned by the party, that there were no sacred cows for Trump, even in the Republican Party, even at Fox News,
sentences.zh: 这表明对于特朗普而言，没有任何神圣不可侵犯的东西，即使是在共和党内，即使是在福克斯新闻台，

sentences.en: even in the primetime and Roger's chosen favorite anchors.
sentences.zh: 即使是在黄金时段和罗杰钦点的主播面前，也是如此。

sentences.en: No one that he would fight anyone.
sentences.zh: 他谁都敢斗，没人能幸免。

sentences.en: You've talked a lot about what a terrible year that was and having to go with armed guards and, you know, having his supporters come after you.
sentences.zh: 你曾多次谈到那一年有多糟糕，不得不带着武装警卫，还有他的支持者对你的攻击。

sentences.en: Do you have sort of residue from that period?
sentences.zh: 你现在还有那段时期的阴影吗？

sentences.en: No, it was such an annoying nine months.
sentences.zh: 不，那九个月真是太烦人了。

sentences.en: You know, I did not want to take an armed guard to Disney World.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我可不想带着武装警卫去迪士尼乐园。

sentences.en: You know, I did not want this to go on and on.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我也不想让这种事没完没了地持续下去。

sentences.en: I knew it wasn't good for me as a journalist, as a Fox News host, or as a person, you know, to have this level of acrimony constantly at me.
sentences.zh: 作为一名记者、一名福克斯新闻的主持人，或者作为一个普通人，我深知这种持续不断的敌意对我来说不是好事。

sentences.en: And I desperately wanted him to just lay off.
sentences.zh: 我当时迫切地希望他能放过我。

sentences.en: So it was just a stressful time when you're just kind of waiting for somebody who's very angry with you and toying with you to, I don't know, get focused on something else
sentences.zh: 那是一段压力很大的时期，你只能等着那个非常生你气、又在捉弄你的人，我不知道，去关注别的事情，

sentences.en: or have those feelings wane enough that they're reachable.
sentences.zh: 或者让那些情绪消退到可以沟通的地步。

sentences.en: In 2016, you and other female Fox employees accused Roger Ailes of sexual harassment.
sentences.zh: 2016年，你和其他福克斯的女员工指控罗杰·艾尔斯性骚扰。

sentences.en: And again, this is a pretty well-documented time in your life.
sentences.zh: 再说一次，这是你人生中记录非常详尽的一段时期。

sentences.en: There was a movie about it.
sentences.zh: 甚至还有一部关于此事的电影。

sentences.en: And ultimately, you were instrumental in getting him fired.
sentences.zh: 最终，你在让他被解雇这件事上发挥了关键作用。

sentences.en: Did you feel at Fox that people were angry at you because of what you've done, certain people?
sentences.zh: 在福克斯，你是否感觉到有些人因为你的所作所为而对你感到愤怒？

sentences.en: Very much so, yes.
sentences.zh: 非常强烈，是的。

sentences.en: They weren't really angry about the Trump stuff.
sentences.zh: 他们并不是真的因为特朗普的事情而生气。

sentences.en: They were angry about me not supporting Roger.
sentences.zh: 他们生气是因为我没有支持罗杰。

sentences.en: And they never got past it.
sentences.zh: 而且他们始终无法释怀。

sentences.en: And I mean, in a way, I feel like my career there ended when I called Lachlan Murdoch to
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，在某种程度上，我觉得我在那里的职业生涯在我给拉克兰·默多克打电话时就结束了，

sentences.en: tell him the truth about how my relationship with Roger was when I was a first-year reporter at Fox.
sentences.zh: 我当时告诉他，我刚进福克斯做第一年记者时，我和罗杰的关系真相。

sentences.en: They just, you have to understand, it's almost cult-like over there.
sentences.zh: 你必须明白，那里简直就像个邪教组织。

sentences.en: At least it was back then.
sentences.zh: 至少当时是这样。

sentences.en: And he was the cult leader.
sentences.zh: 而他就是邪教领袖。

sentences.en: And you don't turn on the cult leader.
sentences.zh: 你不能背叛邪教领袖。

sentences.en: And so, much more so than with the Trump thing, which I think everybody understood Trump, what he was doing.
sentences.zh: 所以，比起特朗普那件事——我认为大家都明白特朗普在做什么——这件事的影响要大得多。

sentences.en: And there were some who took it personally.
sentences.zh: 而且有些人确实对此耿耿于怀。

sentences.en: Hannity and I fought publicly over what he perceived as my non-supportive Trump.
sentences.zh: 汉尼提和我曾公开争吵，因为他认为我不支持特朗普。

sentences.en: So that's not a surprise to anybody.
sentences.zh: 所以这对任何人来说都不足为奇。

sentences.en: But for the most part, no one cared about that.
sentences.zh: 但大多数人并不在乎那个。

sentences.en: It was the Roger thing that turned my relationships at Fox and just made it an impossible place for me to stay.
sentences.zh: 是罗杰的那件事改变了我在福克斯的人际关系，让我无法再待在那里。

sentences.en: And so, I knew I couldn't stay.
sentences.zh: 所以，我知道我待不下去了。

sentences.en: And I left.
sentences.zh: 于是我离开了。

sentences.en: What was that call with Lachlan like, though, when you called him up and told him?
sentences.zh: 那么，当你打电话给拉克兰并告诉他真相时，那通电话是什么样的？

sentences.en: When you asked me that question, I got a chill through my body.
sentences.zh: 当你问我这个问题时，我感到一阵寒意传遍全身。

sentences.en: That's how big that moment was for me.
sentences.zh: 那对我来说就是那么重大的时刻。

sentences.en: It's like one of the hardest, most complicated things I've ever done.
sentences.zh: 那是我做过的最艰难、最复杂的事情之一。

sentences.en: Because I really cared about Roger.
sentences.zh: 因为我真的很在乎罗杰。

sentences.en: And we had gotten past his harassment of me, which, for the record, never led anywhere.
sentences.zh: 我们已经翻过了他对我性骚扰的那一页，顺便说一句，那件事从未有过实质性后果。

sentences.en: I did not submit to any of his advances.
sentences.zh: 我没有屈服于他的任何非分之想。

sentences.en: And I had forgiven him.
sentences.zh: 而且我已经原谅他了。

sentences.en: And he had done so much for me.
sentences.zh: 他为我做了很多事。

sentences.en: And I did not want to hurt him.
sentences.zh: 我不想伤害他。

sentences.en: And I didn't like Gretchen Carlson, who was kind of looking for help, you know, in a way.
sentences.zh: 而且我也不喜欢格雷琴·卡尔森，她当时在某种程度上是在寻求帮助。

sentences.en: The whole question was, could he be this thing that she's alleged he is?
sentences.zh: 整个问题的关键在于，他真的是她所指控的那种人吗？

sentences.en: And I was really not inclined to help her and stick a knife in him.
sentences.zh: 我真的不想去帮她，然后在他背后捅刀子。

sentences.en: So I did wrestle.
sentences.zh: 所以我确实挣扎过。

sentences.en: There was a long period where I wasn't saying anything about it.
sentences.zh: 有一段很长的时间，我对此只字未提。

sentences.en: And people were saying, what's she going to do?
sentences.zh: 人们都在议论，她到底会怎么做？

sentences.en: And I was under a lot of pressure from Roger's team.
sentences.zh: 我当时承受着来自罗杰团队的巨大压力。

sentences.en: And Roger and his wife to come out and say, he's not this thing.
sentences.zh: 罗杰和他的妻子都希望我出来说，他不是那种人。

sentences.en: And he's incapable of being this thing, which is what everyone was saying.
sentences.zh: 而且他不可能做出那种事，这也是当时每个人都在说的。

sentences.en: And I knew I did not have it in me to lie.
sentences.zh: 但我知道我无法撒谎。

sentences.en: The real question was whether I should just stay silent and keep it to myself.
sentences.zh: 真正的问题在于，我是应该保持沉默，把这件事烂在肚子里。

sentences.en: And I wrote about this in my book.
sentences.zh: 我在书中写过这件事。

sentences.en: I was on the porch swing at the place we go to, at the Jersey Shore.
sentences.zh: 当时我正坐在我们去泽西海岸度假时住处的门廊秋千上。

sentences.en: And I was looking at a picture of my daughter who had fallen off the jungle gym.
sentences.zh: 我看着我女儿的照片，她当时从攀爬架上摔了下来。

sentences.en: And she had had something like 11 stitches in her head.
sentences.zh: 她的头上缝了大约11针。

sentences.en: But she got back up to the same jungle gym she had fallen off of.
sentences.zh: 但她又爬回了那个她摔下来的攀爬架上。

sentences.en: And I saw that picture and I said, I have got to call Lachlan Murdoch.
sentences.zh: 我看到那张照片，我说，我必须给拉克兰·默多克打电话。

sentences.en: I have to call him.
sentences.zh: 我必须打给他。

sentences.en: It still makes me emotional because it was something that I think changed lives in a lot of ways.
sentences.zh: 现在回想起来我依然很激动，因为我认为那件事在很多方面改变了人们的生活。

sentences.en: I believe that.
sentences.zh: 我相信这一点。

sentences.en: But including my own in a way that was not positive, mostly.
sentences.zh: 包括我自己的生活，虽然在很大程度上并不是积极的改变。

sentences.en: In some ways positive, but mostly negative.
sentences.zh: 在某些方面是积极的，但大多是负面的。

sentences.en: I'm curious to know, in hindsight, what do you think changed?
sentences.zh: 我很好奇，事后看来，你认为什么改变了？

sentences.en: Well, I think it blew up almost every friendship I had at Fox, which those friendships were important to me.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为它摧毁了我在福克斯几乎所有的友谊，而那些友谊对我来说很重要。

sentences.en: You know, I loved most of those people and didn't quite realize how strong the backlash would be.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我爱那些人中的大多数，当时并没有完全意识到反弹会有多强烈。

sentences.en: I mean, virtually everyone.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，几乎所有人。

sentences.en: Maybe a couple of close friends stood by me and were 100% with me.
sentences.zh: 也许有几个好朋友支持我，百分之百地站在我这边。

sentences.en: But, you know, it just was a before and after moment there.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，那确实是一个分水岭时刻。

sentences.en: Anyway, the whole thing on the heels of that year of the Trump stuff, it was just a lot.
sentences.zh: 总之，在那一年特朗普事件之后，紧接着发生这件事，压力真的很大。

sentences.en: And I'm not generally a stressed out person.
sentences.zh: 我通常不是一个容易焦虑的人。

sentences.en: I probably couldn't be in news if I were anxiety ridden.
sentences.zh: 如果我总是焦虑不安，可能就没法做新闻了。

sentences.en: But I was stressed out.
sentences.zh: 但我当时确实压力很大。

sentences.en: And I left for NBC as an escape.
sentences.zh: 我离开去NBC是为了逃避。

sentences.en: You know, I just thought it was going to be a kinder, gentler.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我当时以为那会是一个更友善、更温和的地方。

sentences.en: My God, I sound like an idiot.
sentences.zh: 天哪，我听起来像个白痴。

sentences.en: It's like I did no homework about anything.
sentences.zh: 就好像我什么功课都没做一样。

sentences.en: Place to be.
sentences.zh: 一个可以待的地方。

sentences.en: It wasn't.
sentences.zh: 结果并不是。

sentences.en: It ended disastrously.
sentences.zh: 结局非常惨烈。

sentences.en: It was an even more stressful year.
sentences.zh: 那一年甚至压力更大。

sentences.en: So, look, all those relationships at Fox have since repaired.
sentences.zh: 所以，你看，福克斯的所有那些关系后来都修复了。

sentences.en: And I'm in a good place with my old Fox colleagues.
sentences.zh: 我和我以前的福克斯同事们关系不错。

sentences.en: But it took a while.
sentences.zh: 但这花了一些时间。

sentences.en: I don't want to spend too much time here because I do want to get to today.
sentences.zh: 我不想在这里花太多时间，因为我确实想谈谈今天的情况。

sentences.en: But you mentioned this in 2017, you went to NBC to host a daytime show.
sentences.zh: 但你提到了2017年，你去NBC主持一档日间节目。

sentences.en: You know, that time at NBC, which was, as you say, so stressful and ended so disastrously because of your comments about blackface and Halloween.
sentences.zh: 你知道，在NBC的那段时间，正如你所说，压力巨大，而且因为你关于黑脸妆和万圣节的评论，结局非常惨烈。

sentences.en: Ostensibly, there was a lot of other things going on at that moment.
sentences.zh: 表面上，当时还有很多其他事情在发生。

sentences.en: But ostensibly, that was the reason that you were arrested.
sentences.zh: 但表面上，那就是你被停职的原因。

sentences.en: Bravo, which is owned by NBC, had a real housewife in blackface Halloween costume.
sentences.zh: Bravo电视台（NBC旗下）有个《真实主妇》的演员在万圣节化了黑脸妆。

sentences.en: She dressed up like Diana Ross and tinted her skin.
sentences.zh: 她打扮成戴安娜·罗斯，把皮肤涂黑了。

sentences.en: And there was a push to not cancel her but get her in trouble.
sentences.zh: 当时有一股舆论压力，不是要封杀她，而是要让她惹上麻烦。

sentences.en: And so we had a discussion on my show where I asked, when did that become unacceptable?
sentences.zh: 所以我们在我的节目中讨论了这个问题，我问，这种行为是从什么时候开始变得不可接受的？

sentences.en: Because when I grew up in the 70s and the 80s, people used to do it.
sentences.zh: 因为当我70年代和80年代长大时，人们经常这样做。

sentences.en: And it was considered okay.
sentences.zh: 而且这被认为是没问题的。

sentences.en: And at the time, I knew that.
sentences.zh: 当时，我是这么认为的。

sentences.en: I knew that had been my experience.
sentences.zh: 我知道那是我的经历。

sentences.en: I just didn't know that NBC had been airing shows with people doing it, like Scrubs.
sentences.zh: 我只是不知道NBC一直在播出人们做这种妆扮的节目，比如《实习医生风云》。

sentences.en: Like, there were so many examples.
sentences.zh: 比如，这样的例子太多了。

sentences.en: But I didn't have it at the ready because I wasn't expecting, like, a huge controversy over it.
sentences.zh: 但我当时没准备好这些例子，因为我没料到会因此引发巨大的争议。

sentences.en: Really?
sentences.zh: 真的吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: At the time, I just thought— But, you know, everyone understands that blackface is raciSt.
sentences.zh: 当时我只是觉得——但是，你知道，每个人都知道黑脸妆是种族歧视。

sentences.en: Now they do.
sentences.zh: 现在他们知道了。

sentences.en: But when did it go from something that people used to do, you know, with impunity—hello, Justin Trudeau—to something that will get you canceled?
sentences.zh: 但它究竟是从什么时候开始，从人们可以肆无忌惮地做的事情——嘿，贾斯廷·特鲁多——变成了会让你被封杀的事情？

sentences.en: And for me, you know, we talked about the two sort of joint traumas during the Fox years, the late Fox years.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，你知道，我们谈到了福克斯后期那两段共同的创伤。

sentences.en: Personally, that NBC, it dwarfed those.
sentences.zh: 个人而言，NBC那次经历让前两次显得微不足道。

sentences.en: So by the time that ended, I was like, this industry is a disgusting, toxic stew of hatred and darkness.
sentences.zh: 所以当那一切结束时，我想，这个行业就是一个充满仇恨和黑暗的恶心、有毒的泥潭。

sentences.en: And why would I want to go back into it?
sentences.zh: 我为什么要回去呢？

sentences.en: You know, now I have some money.
sentences.zh: 你知道，现在我有了一些钱。

sentences.en: Now I'm with my kids.
sentences.zh: 现在我和我的孩子们在一起。

sentences.en: You know, I can raise my family.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我可以抚养我的家庭。

sentences.en: Maybe this is the time I ride into the sunset and find a third version of me professionally.
sentences.zh: 也许现在是我功成身退，寻找职业生涯第三个版本的时候了。

sentences.en: Did you feel during that period that people were turning their back on you, like, because there had been this big flame out at NBC,
sentences.zh: 在那段时期，你是否感觉到人们在背弃你，因为在NBC发生了那场大风波，

sentences.en: that just all that world that you had inhabited had sort of rejected you?
sentences.zh: 感觉你曾经身处的那个世界已经把你抛弃了？

sentences.en: Oh, well, I mean, I had been rendered entirely toxic.
sentences.zh: 哦，嗯，我的意思是，我已经变得完全“有毒”了。

sentences.en: So I guess I never really tested it.
sentences.zh: 所以我猜我从未真正测试过这一点。

sentences.en: I wasn't out seeking jobs at that time, right?
sentences.zh: 那时我并没有在找工作，对吧？

sentences.en: It wasn't like, gee, will anyone still have me?
sentences.zh: 并不是说，天哪，还有人会要我吗？

sentences.en: But I understood that I had been rendered toxic.
sentences.zh: 但我明白我已经变得“有毒”了。

sentences.en: This was the moment when, you've talked about this on your new show, when you sort of decided the mainstream media is not for me.
sentences.zh: 这就是那个时刻，你在你的新节目中谈到过，当你决定主流媒体不再适合我的时候。

sentences.en: I can't have, I don't do well with bosses, as it turns out.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，我处理不好与老板的关系。

sentences.en: I'm not that easy to control as an employee.
sentences.zh: 作为员工，我没那么容易被控制。

sentences.en: I'm just kind of past the bullshit.
sentences.zh: 我只是厌倦了那些废话。

sentences.en: And also that the landscape had changed back in 20, you know, I was on my couch, figuratively, like all of 2019.
sentences.zh: 而且环境在20年时也变了，你知道，我基本上整个2019年都坐在沙发上。

sentences.en: And the beginning of 2020.
sentences.zh: 还有2020年初。

sentences.en: And the country was losing its mind.
sentences.zh: 整个国家都快疯了。

sentences.en: That was peak wokeism.
sentences.zh: 那是“觉醒文化”的巅峰时期。

sentences.en: You know, where when it came to race, when it came to gender, when it came to any LGBTQ, it was like we were going nuts.
sentences.zh: 你知道，在种族、性别、LGBTQ这些议题上，我们当时简直要疯了。

sentences.en: And I am not a woke person.
sentences.zh: 而且我并不是一个“觉醒派”。

sentences.en: It's one of my core missions in life to defeat wokeism.
sentences.zh: 击败“觉醒主义”是我的人生核心使命之一。

sentences.en: Anyway, there was no way I could go work for another broadcast news outlet that was going to be like NBC was.
sentences.zh: 总之，我不可能再去另一家像NBC那样的广播新闻机构工作了。

sentences.en: I definitely couldn't go back to Fox.
sentences.zh: 我绝对不可能回到福克斯（Fox）。

sentences.en: That bridge had already been burned on my way out.
sentences.zh: 我离开时就已经把那座桥烧断了。

sentences.en: And I wasn't in a great place with the executives or the owners.
sentences.zh: 而且我和高管或老板们的关系也不太好。

sentences.en: So it was like, what could I possibly do?
sentences.zh: 所以当时就在想，我还能做什么呢？

sentences.en: Like, what's an avenue available to me?
sentences.zh: 我还有什么路可走？

sentences.en: And that's when Ben Shapiro called me, who I think he would tell you, I helped him make his name.
sentences.zh: 就在那时，本·夏皮罗（Ben Shapiro）给我打了电话，我想他自己也会告诉你，是我帮他打响了名声。

sentences.en: I put him on the Kelly file regularly and helped make him a star.
sentences.zh: 我经常让他上《凯利档案》（The Kelly File）节目，帮他成为了明星。

sentences.en: And he saw me down and out and he said, MK, this is a real lane for you.
sentences.zh: 他看到我陷入低谷，就对我说：“梅根，这确实是一条适合你的路。”

sentences.en: And he was just saying it as a friend.
sentences.zh: 他当时只是以朋友的身份这么说。

sentences.en: And I wasn't quite ready at first, but then he called me again and said, you got to get back out there.
sentences.zh: 起初我还没准备好，但他又打来电话说：“你得重新出发。”

sentences.en: And he said, why don't you come out here to the Daily Wire and just see what we're doing?
sentences.zh: 他说：“你为什么不来《每日连线》（Daily Wire）看看我们在做什么呢？”

sentences.en: And I, whatever, kicked the tires on this new lane and thought, this is what I want to do.
sentences.zh: 于是，不管怎样，我试水了这条新路，心想：这就是我想做的。

sentences.en: Why?
sentences.zh: 为什么？

sentences.en: Because I was my own boss.
sentences.zh: 因为我是自己的老板。

sentences.en: I could be in charge of all my own editorial.
sentences.zh: 我可以掌控自己所有的编辑内容。

sentences.en: No one could tell me what to do, what to say, what not to say.
sentences.zh: 没人能告诉我该做什么、该说什么、不该说什么。

sentences.en: I could have long form conversations about really tough issues that were bubbling up in the country at the time.
sentences.zh: 我可以就当时国内涌现的棘手问题进行深度对话。

sentences.en: I didn't have to do it in a seven-minute segment or a three-minute segment like I used to have to do on linear television.
sentences.zh: 我不必像在传统电视上那样，非得把内容压缩在七分钟或三分钟的片段里。

sentences.en: It was just a whole new world to me.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，这简直是一个全新的世界。

sentences.en: It was the Wild West to me.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，这就是一片蛮荒之地。

sentences.en: And I loved that feeling.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢那种感觉。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I mean, you've talked about finding a third version of Megyn Kelly with your new show, which is on YouTube.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你曾谈到通过你的新节目（在YouTube上）寻找“第三版梅根·凯利”。

sentences.en: Looking at the early days of your show, when you first started, it was very much like you were an anchor on television.
sentences.zh: 回顾你节目刚开始的时候，你看起来非常像电视上的主播。

sentences.en: And now you look a lot looser.
sentences.zh: 而现在你看起来放松多了。

sentences.en: Yes, and I feel looser, you know, in the anchor sense.
sentences.zh: 是的，我觉得自己更放松了，你知道，在主播的意义上。

sentences.en: But if you really want to make it as an individual, like in this lane, without a platform supporting you, you know, where they're tuning in because it's Fox News, you know,
sentences.zh: 但如果你真的想以个人身份在这条路上成功，没有平台支持你，观众不是因为它是福克斯新闻才收看，

sentences.en: and you just follow the person before you who they really liked.
sentences.zh: 也不是因为你只是顺着他们喜欢的上一位主持人接着播，

sentences.en: There has to be a connection between your audience and you.
sentences.zh: 那么你和观众之间就必须建立起联系。

sentences.en: Otherwise, what's the point?
sentences.zh: 否则，意义何在呢？

sentences.en: And so I did start to share more of my own opinions.
sentences.zh: 所以我开始分享更多我自己的观点。

sentences.en: And frankly, I started to form more of my own opinions.
sentences.zh: 坦白说，我也开始形成更多我自己的观点。

sentences.en: Tell me about that.
sentences.zh: 跟我说说这个。

sentences.en: Form your own opinions.
sentences.zh: 形成你自己的观点。

sentences.en: Well, because I was never really that political, as I said, growing up.
sentences.zh: 嗯，因为正如我所说，我成长过程中其实并不怎么关心政治。

sentences.en: One of the reasons I think I did well at Fox in the news division was I didn't really feel the need to choose a side.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我在福克斯新闻部做得不错的原因之一，就是我真的没觉得有必要选边站。

sentences.en: I just felt the need to learn everything I could about both of the sides and then mediate a good debate.
sentences.zh: 我只是觉得有必要尽可能多地了解双方，然后主持一场好的辩论。

sentences.en: Then it wasn't until really I got on this show that it was a different job.
sentences.zh: 直到我做了这个节目，工作性质才发生了变化。

sentences.en: It was more like they wanted to know what I thought.
sentences.zh: 更像是他们想知道我的想法。

sentences.en: That was clear.
sentences.zh: 这一点很明确。

sentences.en: The audience wanted to know my opinion.
sentences.zh: 观众想知道我的观点。

sentences.en: And so on a lot of subjects, I had to really start thinking about them.
sentences.zh: 所以对于很多议题，我真的必须开始思考。

sentences.en: Like even today, we're having a debate about tariffs.
sentences.zh: 比如今天，我们正在讨论关税问题。

sentences.en: I don't know how I feel about tariffs.
sentences.zh: 我不知道自己对关税有什么看法。

sentences.en: I've never really given it a lot of thought.
sentences.zh: 我以前从未深入思考过这个问题。

sentences.en: So I'm working on my opinion on tariffs.
sentences.zh: 所以我正在整理我对关税的看法。

sentences.en: But there have been a million subjects like that over the past four or five years that I've really just had to question where I stand.
sentences.zh: 但在过去四五年里，有上百万个类似的问题，我真的不得不审视自己的立场。

sentences.en: One of the things that you just did, which is a red line for most journalists,
sentences.zh: 你刚才做的一件事，对大多数记者来说是红线，

sentences.en: is that you showed up at one of Donald Trump's rallies right before the election and you formally endorsed him.
sentences.zh: 那就是你在大选前夕出现在唐纳德·特朗普的集会上，并正式为他背书。

sentences.en: Once you endorse a politician on stage at a rally, I don't think you can reasonably be called independent anymore.
sentences.zh: 一旦你在集会舞台上为政客背书，我认为你就不能再被称为独立人士了。

sentences.en: Or do you see it differently?
sentences.zh: 还是说你有不同的看法？

sentences.en: I think I can.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我可以。

sentences.en: I don't agree with that.
sentences.zh: 我不同意那种说法。

sentences.en: Because I can still hit Trump and do.
sentences.zh: 因为我仍然可以抨击特朗普，而且我也确实在做。

sentences.en: You know, there's no question that I owned my bias on Trump and crossed a line that I had never crossed before and never would have crossed when I was still straight news, ever.
sentences.zh: 你知道，毫无疑问，我承认了我在特朗普问题上的偏见，跨越了一条我以前从未跨越、在做纯新闻时也绝不会跨越的界限。

sentences.en: It's just this weird new hybrid lane I'm in that even made it a possibility in my mind, you know, that I even allowed myself to consider saying yes to the invitation.
sentences.zh: 这只是我所处的这种奇怪的新型混合赛道，甚至让我觉得这成为了一种可能，你知道，我甚至允许自己考虑接受邀请。

sentences.en: And it was another before and after moment because for sure you're crossing a line.
sentences.zh: 这又是另一个“之前与之后”的时刻，因为你确实跨越了界限。

sentences.en: But I had crossed it prior to then.
sentences.zh: 但我在此之前就已经跨越了。

sentences.en: I had crossed it the day Biden handed down his Title IX revisions.
sentences.zh: 在拜登颁布《第九条修正案》修订案的那天，我就已经跨越了。

sentences.en: And I was so angry about what he did that I went on my show that day and said, I'm voting for Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 我对他的所作所为感到非常愤怒，以至于那天我在节目中说：“我要投票给唐纳德·特朗普。”

sentences.en: And I had never done that.
sentences.zh: 我以前从未这样做过。

sentences.en: But then going and actively campaigning, standing on stage and, you know, giving him a hug and a kiss, it is different.
sentences.zh: 但后来去积极参加竞选活动，站在台上，你知道，拥抱并亲吻他，这确实不同。

sentences.en: And I think a lot of people saw you endorsing Trump as caving, as essentially going to where the power is.
sentences.zh: 我想很多人认为你为特朗普背书是屈服，本质上是投靠权力。

sentences.en: I don't think it was me caving.
sentences.zh: 我不认为那是屈服。

sentences.en: It was me rising.
sentences.zh: 那是我的崛起。

sentences.en: It was me answering something I truly felt called to do.
sentences.zh: 那是我在回应内心真正呼唤我去做的事情。

sentences.en: I'm thrilled Trump won.
sentences.zh: 我很高兴特朗普赢了。

sentences.en: I shudder to think of what the country would be right now if Kamala Harris had won.
sentences.zh: 我不敢想象如果卡玛拉·哈里斯赢了，现在的国家会是什么样子。

sentences.en: And in the end, I had no qualms about going there out there for him whatsoever.
sentences.zh: 最终，我对于去现场支持他没有任何顾虑。

sentences.en: And I accept and agree with you that there's there are different gradations.
sentences.zh: 我接受并同意你的观点，即存在不同的程度。

sentences.en: It is a different level.
sentences.zh: 这确实是不同的层面。

sentences.en: You know, the symbolism of it, of course, which is someone who so famously had been at odds with him that he had done so much to to publicly stand up and embrace him.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这其中的象征意义，当然，对于一个曾以与他针锋相对而闻名的人来说，公开站出来拥抱他，意义重大。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And that was significant to a lot of people.
sentences.zh: 这对很多人来说意义重大。

sentences.en: I hope so.
sentences.zh: 我希望如此。

sentences.en: I mean, that was my goal in helping him, especially with women.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这就是我帮助他的目标，特别是在女性选民方面。

sentences.en: And I wanted to look them in the eyes figuratively and say, trust me, you know, I'm pro-woman.
sentences.zh: 我想在比喻意义上看着她们的眼睛说：“相信我，我是支持女性的。”

sentences.en: And, you know, I've expressed doubts about him in the past about some of the choices he's made when it came to dealing with women.
sentences.zh: 你知道，过去我曾对他处理女性问题时的一些选择表示过怀疑。

sentences.en: But there is no other choice for women in this election.
sentences.zh: 但在这次选举中，女性别无选择。

sentences.en: And I stand by that wholeheartedly for all the reasons I listed that night.
sentences.zh: 我全心全意地坚持我那天列出的所有理由。

sentences.en: Like, I knew that I could be of help to him.
sentences.zh: 我知道我可以帮到他。

sentences.en: I knew, given the relationship with him,
sentences.zh: 我知道，鉴于我和他的关系，

sentences.en: that I would be a different kind of endorser that actually might potentially make a difference for him with a certain set of people who were looking for permission to vote for him because they'd been told universally that he was bad,
sentences.zh: 我会成为一个不同类型的背书人，这可能会让某些正在寻找投票许可的人对他产生改观，因为他们一直被告知他很糟糕，

sentences.en: that he was Hitler, that he was a rapist, that all these things that people have been saying.
sentences.zh: 说他是希特勒，是强奸犯，以及人们所说的所有那些事情。

sentences.en: And I felt the obligation to go tell them how I really feel about him and why I feel that way.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我有义务去告诉他们我对他的真实感受，以及我为什么会有这种感受。

sentences.en: I understand the fervor within, you know, which you embrace some of his policies.
sentences.zh: 我理解你拥护他某些政策时的那种热情。

sentences.en: But what you were talking about there was the person himself, the things that he has been accused of, credibly accused of, and what you yourself experienced.
sentences.zh: 但你刚才谈论的是他本人，是他被指控的那些事，那些可信的指控，以及你自己亲身经历的事情。

sentences.en: I'll give you the perspective on it.
sentences.zh: 我来给你提供一个视角。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So I don't agree with you on the credibly accused.
sentences.zh: 关于“可信的指控”，我不同意你的看法。

sentences.en: I actually don't believe that.
sentences.zh: 我其实并不相信那些。

sentences.en: But with respect to my own situation, you have to zoom out and look what was happening at the time, which was not easy for me when I was going through it.
sentences.zh: 但就我自己的情况而言，你必须跳出来看当时发生了什么，这在我经历的时候并不容易。

sentences.en: But Trump was trying to win a presidential election.
sentences.zh: 但特朗普当时正试图赢得总统大选。

sentences.en: And so, as I pointed out earlier, it was useful to him to have me as a foil.
sentences.zh: 所以，正如我之前指出的，让他把我当作陪衬对他是有利的。

sentences.en: Look, you have to separate when you're in this business, you the person and you the professional.
sentences.zh: 听着，在这个行业里，你必须把“作为个人的你”和“作为专业人士的你”分开。

sentences.en: Now, Megyn Kelly, the woman, and Megyn Kelly, the brand.
sentences.zh: 现在，梅根·凯利是个人，梅根·凯利是品牌。

sentences.en: And they were attacking Megyn Kelly, the brand, which is fair game.
sentences.zh: 他们攻击的是“梅根·凯利”这个品牌，这是公平竞争。

sentences.en: You know, I had thrown a very tough ball right at Trump's face.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我曾向特朗普的脸上投掷了一个非常棘手的球。

sentences.en: You really think it's fair game that you as a journalist ask a fair question based on things that he'd said and he put you through that for a whole year?
sentences.zh: 你真的认为，作为一名记者，基于他说过的话提出一个公平的问题，然后他让你整整一年都处于那种境地，这叫公平竞争吗？

sentences.en: You think that's fair?
sentences.zh: 你觉得这公平吗？

sentences.en: Look, I've been very public about thinking he went too far.
sentences.zh: 听着，我曾公开表示过他做得太过分了。

sentences.en: You know, that's how I felt at the time.
sentences.zh: 你知道，当时我就是这么感觉的。

sentences.en: And if I could go back and undo it, I would.
sentences.zh: 如果能重来，我会撤回那件事。

sentences.en: But I have a better perspective on why it happened now.
sentences.zh: 但我现在对这件事发生的原因有了更好的理解。

sentences.en: You know, it was actually an important piece of his rise within the Republican Party in the primary.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这实际上是他党内初选崛起过程中的重要一环。

sentences.en: And it just showed people what a fighter he was.
sentences.zh: 它向人们展示了他是一个多么强悍的斗士。

sentences.en: The same guy who got up bloodied in Butler, Pennsylvania, was the guy who was like a dog with a bone with me, who wouldn't let it go.
sentences.zh: 那个在宾夕法尼亚州巴特勒受伤后站起来的人，就是那个像狗咬骨头一样盯着我不放的人。

sentences.en: He's got this fighter instinct.
sentences.zh: 他有一种斗士的本能。

sentences.en: And if you cross him or if you do something he finds unjust, he will stay on you until he's satisfied the thing's been resolved to his satisfaction.
sentences.zh: 如果你冒犯了他，或者做了他认为不公正的事，他会一直盯着你，直到他认为事情得到了令他满意的解决。

sentences.en: I just want to understand something clearly.
sentences.zh: 我只是想清楚地了解一件事。

sentences.en: Donald Trump was found liable for sexual abuse in a civil court.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普在民事法庭上被裁定对性虐待负有责任。

sentences.en: He's been accused by many women.
sentences.zh: 他被许多女性指控过。

sentences.en: You don't believe any of that?
sentences.zh: 你一点都不相信这些吗？

sentences.en: I think the most serious thing I've heard about him has been the E.
sentences.zh: 我认为我听到的关于他最严重的事情是E·简·卡罗尔（E. Jean Carroll）的指控，说他在波道夫·古德曼（Bergdorf）的更衣室里性侵了她。

sentences.en: Jean Carroll allegation that he sexually assaulted her in a Bergdorf dressing room.
sentences.zh: 我一个字都不信。

sentences.en: And I don't believe one word of that.
sentences.zh: 还有其他女性说过——

sentences.en: There are other women who have said—
sentences.zh: 哦，我知道。

sentences.en: Oh, I know.
sentences.zh: 我采访过她们中的一些人。

sentences.en: I've interviewed some of them.
sentences.zh: 但听着，我听到的事情还包括他在飞机上动手动脚之类的。

sentences.en: But look, the things I heard were included things like he got handsy on an airplane.
sentences.zh: 现在，我不知道那是否发生过。

sentences.en: Now, I don't know whether that happened or it didn't.
sentences.zh: 但我觉得这对于一个潜在的政客来说是不可接受的吗？

sentences.en: But do I find that a deal breaker for a possible politician?
sentences.zh: 并不完全是。

sentences.en: Not really.
sentences.zh: 我有幸把这些带到数百万人的广播中，让观众自己做决定。

sentences.en: Courtesy of bringing them to air in front of millions of people and let the audience make up its mind.
sentences.zh: 我的问题更多在于那些民主党人，他们会掩盖针对他们候选人或候选人配偶的指控，然后在审视唐纳德·特朗普时表现得道貌岸然。

sentences.en: My problem is more with these Democrats who will bury these allegations against their candidates or their candidate spouses and then play holier-than-thou when they're looking at Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 你还认为自己是一名记者吗？

sentences.en: Do you see yourself as a journalist still?
sentences.zh: 还是说你不再这样描述自己了？

sentences.en: Or would you not describe yourself like that anymore?
sentences.zh: 不，我仍然是一名记者。

sentences.en: No, I'm still a journaliSt.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我一直在报道独家新闻。

sentences.en: I mean, I break news all the time.
sentences.zh: 当我与特朗普或政府中的任何人坐下来谈话时，我会提出尖锐的问题。

sentences.en: And when I sit with Trump or anybody else in the administration, I ask tough questions.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，就在23年9月，我采访了特朗普，他对我非常生气，有六七个月没跟我说话。

sentences.en: I mean, as recently as September of 23, I interviewed Trump, and he got so mad at me, he didn't talk to me for six or seven months.
sentences.zh: 所以这不是——听着，这是一份艰苦的工作。

sentences.en: So it's not—look, it's a tough job to do.
sentences.zh: 你必须有能力抨击你钦佩的人。

sentences.en: You have to be able to hit the people you admire.
sentences.zh: 而我做到了。

sentences.en: And I do.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我抨击过他们所有人。

sentences.en: You know, I've hit them all.

sentences.en: Right before the election, I ripped on Trump's Madison Square Garden rally as too bro-tastic and got specific about why.
sentences.zh: 你必须明白，如果你没有出卖灵魂，你就必须愿意批评那些即使是你钦佩的、所谓的“你这一边”的人。

sentences.en: You have to understand, like, if you haven't sold your soul, you have to be willing to criticize the people even you that you admire on your, quote, side.
sentences.zh: 我通过和唐纳德·特朗普一起站在舞台上，说我投票给他，你们也应该投票给他，这种承认偏见的行为，反而为我的信誉加了分。

sentences.en: And my owning my bias by going out there on stage with Donald Trump and saying I'm voting for him and you should too is a bonus when it comes to my credibility.
sentences.zh: 现在，每个人对我站在哪一边都毫无疑问，他们可以通过适当的视角来过滤我所说的一切。

sentences.en: Now, everybody has zero doubt about where I stand, and they can filter everything I say through the appropriate lens.
sentences.zh: 新闻界通常发生的情况是，他们声称自己没有偏见，然后就在文字或节目中表现出来，却不承认。

sentences.en: What typically happens in journalism is they say they have no bias, and then they just work it out in the printed word or on their shows without owning it.
sentences.zh: 但观众心里清楚，这造成了不信任和分裂。

sentences.en: But the audience knows it, and it creates a distrust and a divide.
sentences.zh: 至于我和特朗普，不，我个人的观点是，针对他的大多数指控比主流媒体让你相信的要复杂得多。

sentences.en: When it comes to Trump and me, no, my own personal opinion is most of the allegations against him are much more complicated than the mainstream media would have you believe.
sentences.zh: 我不认为唐纳德·特朗普是强奸犯或性侵犯者。

sentences.en: And I don't think Donald Trump is a rapist or a sexual assaulter.
sentences.zh: 我确实认为他曾对女性采取过不当行为，并以他自己承认的方式对她们动手动脚，好吗？

sentences.en: I do think he's taken inappropriate liberties with women and gotten handsy with them in a way he's owned himself, okay?
sentences.zh: 那是多年前他还是名人时的事了，事实就是这样。

sentences.en: Years ago when he was a celebrity, and it is what it is.
sentences.zh: 那已经是过去式了。

sentences.en: That's the paSt.
sentences.zh: 那已经是过去式了。

sentences.en: But it's just about so much more than that.
sentences.zh: 但这远不止于此。

sentences.en: We are talking about how many people dying at the southern border because of the invasion that we've suffered under Joe Biden.
sentences.zh: 我们谈论的是在乔·拜登治下，由于我们所遭受的这场入侵，南部边境有多少人因此丧生。

sentences.en: We're talking about Lincoln Riley, whose killer was led in under Biden.
sentences.zh: 我们谈论的是林肯·莱利，他的杀手是在拜登的领导下被放进来的。

sentences.en: We put him on a taxpayer flight down to Georgia where he murdered her.
sentences.zh: 我们用纳税人的钱送他飞往佐治亚州，他在那里杀害了她。

sentences.en: I don't give a shit about Trump getting handsy with somebody 20 years ago.
sentences.zh: 我根本不在乎特朗普20年前对某人动手动脚的事。

sentences.en: I want someone who will close the border, which he has.
sentences.zh: 我想要的是一个能关闭边境的人，而他做到了。

sentences.en: I want someone who will keep boys out of my daughter's sports, which he has.
sentences.zh: 我想要的是一个能把男生挡在我女儿运动项目之外的人，而他做到了。

sentences.en: I want someone who will stand up to the insane DEI policies so that white kids will stop hearing in school that they're born with some original sin from which they cannot recover,
sentences.zh: 我想要的是一个能挺身对抗疯狂的DEI政策的人，这样白人孩子在学校里就不会再听到他们生来就带着无法洗脱的原罪这种说法，

sentences.en: which he has.
sentences.zh: 而他做到了。

sentences.en: Do you think you could be at Fox now in the way that you were before?
sentences.zh: 你觉得你现在还能像以前那样在福克斯工作吗？

sentences.en: Can I rein back in the opinion me and like do what I used to do without sharing it as much and just sort of be straight down the middle?
sentences.zh: 我能收敛一下我的观点，像以前那样做，而不去过多分享，只是保持中立吗？

sentences.en: If sometimes opinionated, I could, but I don't have any interest in that.
sentences.zh: 如果偶尔发表意见的话，我可以，但我对此毫无兴趣。

sentences.en: And I actually don't think that's the model for the future either.
sentences.zh: 而且我实际上认为那也不是未来的模式。

sentences.en: Tell me what you mean by that.
sentences.zh: 说说看你这话是什么意思。

sentences.en: I just think that mode of journalism is dying, if not dead.
sentences.zh: 我只是认为那种新闻模式正在消亡，如果还没死的话。

sentences.en: I think the future involves direct relationships between individual journalists and their audience or personalities.
sentences.zh: 我认为未来在于个人记者或公众人物与受众之间的直接联系。

sentences.en: They don't all have to consider themselves journalists and their audience.
sentences.zh: 他们不必非得把自己视为记者，也不必把受众视为受众。

sentences.en: What's left if that happens?
sentences.zh: 如果那样的话，还剩下什么呢？

sentences.en: I mean, the way that the algorithms work now is that I agree with you.
sentences.zh: 我是说，现在的算法运作方式是，我同意你的观点。

sentences.en: They elevate individuals, that you have a personal relationship with them, but you're given more of the same thing that you want, right?
sentences.zh: 它们提升了个人地位，让你与他们建立个人联系，但你得到的只是更多你想要的同类内容，对吧？

sentences.en: So if I like Megyn Kelly, I might get Megyn Kelly adjacent materials.
sentences.zh: 所以如果我喜欢梅根·凯利，我可能会得到与梅根·凯利相关的内容。

sentences.en: So however great Megyn Kelly may or may not be, that is a very narrow slice of what's out there.
sentences.zh: 所以无论梅根·凯利本人有多棒，那也只是外界信息中非常狭窄的一小部分。

sentences.en: The reality right now or the way it's been for the past three decades prior to the last couple of years is everyone is siloed and they're all getting only leftist information.
sentences.zh: 现实情况是，或者说在过去几年之前的三十年里，每个人都被隔绝在各自的信息茧房里，他们只接收左翼信息。

sentences.en: There's like the people who watch Fox and then everybody else.
sentences.zh: 就像是看福克斯的人和其他所有人。

sentences.en: There is a monopoly on opinion and political bias, mostly by the left and media.
sentences.zh: 舆论和政治偏见存在垄断，主要由左派和媒体掌控。

sentences.en: And a couple have popped up that have done all right.
sentences.zh: 但也冒出了几个做得还不错的。

sentences.en: Fox, they do very well.
sentences.zh: 福克斯，他们做得很好。

sentences.en: The Wall Street Journal is doing okay.
sentences.zh: 《华尔街日报》做得还可以。

sentences.en: And that's it.
sentences.zh: 也就这些了。

sentences.en: You've had talk radio, which was the only place conservatives could go to hear their ideas debated in a way that wasn't disdainful.
sentences.zh: 你以前有谈话广播，那是保守派唯一能听到他们的观点以一种非蔑视的方式进行辩论的地方。

sentences.en: And now that lane has been broadened out to more radio and digital, where you have more conservative personalities dominating.
sentences.zh: 而现在这个渠道已经扩展到更多的广播和数字媒体，在那里你有更多的保守派人物占据主导地位。

sentences.en: Because necessity is the mother of all invention.
sentences.zh: 因为需求是发明之母。

sentences.en: Because there are more conservatives in the country now than there are liberals.
sentences.zh: 因为现在国内的保守派比自由派多。

sentences.en: The country is more right-leaning than it is left.
sentences.zh: 这个国家比左倾更右倾。

sentences.en: Why wouldn't they be the dominant forces in media, in mainstream so-called media?
sentences.zh: 为什么他们不能成为媒体，也就是所谓的传统媒体中的主导力量呢？

sentences.en: Because there's a monopoly.
sentences.zh: 因为存在垄断。

sentences.en: There's control.
sentences.zh: 存在控制。

sentences.en: There's control over sports.
sentences.zh: 对体育有控制。

sentences.en: There's control over corporate America.
sentences.zh: 对美国企业界有控制。

sentences.en: There's control over media.
sentences.zh: 对媒体有控制。

sentences.en: And Republicans have had this one strain, and Fox News has been very important, but they needed to invent a new area of thought.
sentences.zh: 共和党人一直有这一脉，福克斯新闻一直很重要，但他们需要开辟一个新的思想领域。

sentences.en: Because even Fox wasn't enough and actually didn't represent all Republican voices.
sentences.zh: 因为即使是福克斯也不够，而且实际上并没有代表所有共和党人的声音。

sentences.en: So I do think now that this other thing has been invented, the old thing is a dinosaur.
sentences.zh: 所以我确实认为，既然现在已经发明了这种新事物，旧事物就是恐龙了。

sentences.en: It's dying a slow and painful death.
sentences.zh: 它正在经历一场缓慢而痛苦的死亡。

sentences.en: Part of it is tragic because we do need reporters.
sentences.zh: 其中一部分是悲剧，因为我们确实需要记者。

sentences.en: We need news gatherers.
sentences.zh: 我们需要新闻采集者。

sentences.en: And I am not somebody who says the Times should go out of business.
sentences.zh: 我并不是那种说《纽约时报》应该倒闭的人。

sentences.en: I still subscribe to the Times.
sentences.zh: 我仍然订阅《纽约时报》。

sentences.en: I also subscribe to the Journal, and I subscribe to the New York PoSt.
sentences.zh: 我也订阅《华尔街日报》，还订阅《纽约邮报》。

sentences.en: I think it's important to have news gatherers out there getting news.
sentences.zh: 我认为有新闻采集者在外面获取新闻很重要。

sentences.en: And people like me cannot exist without that.
sentences.zh: 像我这样的人没有他们就无法生存。

sentences.en: You know, I need content.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我需要内容。

sentences.en: I need news to talk about and report on.
sentences.zh: 我需要新闻来谈论和报道。

sentences.en: But the model for, you know, how that news is presented is deeply, deeply flawed.
sentences.zh: 但那种新闻呈现的模式，存在着非常、非常严重的缺陷。

sentences.en: And it led to me, and it's going to lead to a much different future for those organizations.
sentences.zh: 它造就了我，也将为那些机构带来一个截然不同的未来。

sentences.zh: 休息之后，我给梅根回了电话，她说出了我们俩都在想的事情。

sentences.en: I feel like part of our discussion before and today is getting at something that, like, our wires are crossing.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我们之前和今天的讨论部分触及了一些东西，就像我们的频道对不上一样。

sentences.en: Your wires and my wires are crossing in a way.
sentences.zh: 你的频道和我的频道在某种程度上对不上。

sentences.zh: 我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.zh: 我喜欢试着捉弄你。

sentences.zh: 我是Sam Mazursky，我每天负责制作《Spelling Bee》和《Letterboxd》游戏。

sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由人制作的，就像你刚才听到的那些人一样。

sentences.zh: 访问nytimes.com/games，今天就开始玩吧。

sentences.zh: 我一直在思考我们的谈话。

sentences.en: And you were talking about how you still consider yourself a journalist, even though the way you do the work has sort of changed over time.
sentences.zh: 你谈到尽管你做工作的方式随着时间推移发生了一些变化，但你仍然认为自己是一名记者。

sentences.en: And so I did want to ask you, as someone who supports the president, what you make of the various ways that he attacks the press,
sentences.zh: 所以我确实想问你，作为一名支持总统的人，你如何看待他攻击媒体的各种方式，

sentences.en: from calling reporters the enemy of the people to sort of popularizing the term fake news, sometimes calling out individual reporters.
sentences.zh: 从称记者为人民公敌，到普及“假新闻”这个词，有时还点名批评个别记者。

sentences.en: What do you make of that dynamic?
sentences.zh: 你如何看待这种动态？

sentences.en: I'm in favor of it.
sentences.zh: 我支持这样做。

sentences.en: I share his feelings.
sentences.zh: 我认同他的感受。

sentences.en: You know, I just, like most people on the right, I have a healthy amount of loathing for a large portion of the media.
sentences.zh: 你知道，就像右翼的大多数人一样，我对很大一部分媒体有着健康的厌恶感。

sentences.en: And they are fake news.
sentences.zh: 它们就是假新闻。

sentences.en: And Trump did a very effective job of pointing that out.
sentences.zh: 特朗普在指出这一点上做得非常有效。

sentences.en: And he had to, because they were all against him.
sentences.zh: 他必须这样做，因为他们都反对他。

sentences.en: So what was his choice, other than to try to demonize them as a group?
sentences.zh: 所以除了试图把他们作为一个群体妖魔化，他还有什么选择呢？

sentences.en: And rather than proving him wrong, they leaned in and tried extra hard to really convince people of what he was saying.
sentences.zh: 他们非但没有证明他是错的，反而变本加厉，更加努力地去说服人们相信他所说的话。

sentences.en: That's what happened, especially over Trump 1.0.
sentences.zh: 这就是发生的事情，特别是在特朗普1.0时期。

sentences.en: He played a role, but it was really their decision, but they needed a little bit of help, and he provided it.
sentences.zh: 他扮演了一个角色，但那确实是他们的决定，不过他们需要一点帮助，而他提供了帮助。

sentences.en: President Trump has chosen a lot of people who are in the media, especially on Fox for his administration.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统为他的政府挑选了很多媒体界的人，特别是在福克斯工作的人。

sentences.en: The most high profile, of course, Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth, whom you worked with, Deputy Director of the FBI Dan Bongino.
sentences.zh: 最引人注目的当然是国防部长皮特·海格塞斯，你曾与他共事，还有联邦调查局副局长丹·邦吉诺。

sentences.en: There are many others.
sentences.zh: 还有很多其他人。

sentences.en: As someone who spent so much time in that world, I'm curious what you make of that.
sentences.zh: 作为一个在那个世界待了这么久的人，我很好奇你是怎么看的。

sentences.en: I'm excited about it.
sentences.zh: 我很兴奋。

sentences.en: Pete Hegseth is an interesting one.
sentences.zh: 皮特·海格塞斯是一个有趣的例子。

sentences.en: And I would just say, like, he's a good example of what I was saying to you yesterday about how we have an approach that, irrespective of who I voted for,
sentences.zh: 我只想说，他很好地印证了我昨天对你说的，无论我投给谁，我们都有这样一种方法，

sentences.en: we try to make it relentlessly factual.
sentences.zh: 我们努力做到毫不留情地客观。

sentences.en: When the allegations against him that he allegedly raped somebody came out, we sat on this show and went line by line through the police report.
sentences.zh: 当针对他涉嫌强奸某人的指控出来时，我们在这个节目中逐行阅读了警方报告。

sentences.en: And it was brutal.
sentences.zh: 那非常残酷。

sentences.en: And we did not care that he was a Trump appointee.
sentences.zh: 我们不在乎他是特朗普的任命人选。

sentences.en: We did not care that he was a former friend and colleague of mine at Fox.
sentences.zh: 我们不在乎他是我在福克斯的前朋友和同事。

sentences.en: We read every single allegation against him and went through it with the audience with an open mind.
sentences.zh: 我们阅读了针对他的每一项指控，并以开放的心态与观众一起进行了分析。

sentences.en: Good luck finding somebody else who did that.
sentences.zh: 祝你好运，去找到另一个这样做的人吧。

sentences.en: It didn't happen.
sentences.zh: 这没发生过。

sentences.zh: 嗯，你采访了他。

sentences.en: And it was a fair interview, a tough interview.
sentences.zh: 那是一次公平的采访，一次艰难的采访。

sentences.en: But you opened it by saying, you know, that he was a friend.
sentences.zh: 但你开场时说，你知道，他是你的朋友。

sentences.en: You said, I've been really dismayed by the amount of pylon that he's been suffering.
sentences.zh: 你说，我对他在遭受的猛烈抨击感到非常沮丧。

sentences.en: And I've been outraged by the unfairness of the media's coverage of the allegations.
sentences.zh: 我对媒体报道这些指控的不公正感到愤怒。

sentences.en: And that's a direct quote.
sentences.zh: 这是直接引用。

sentences.en: And so I'm curious what you're doing in that interview,
sentences.zh: 所以我很好奇你在那次采访中在做什么，

sentences.en: because you're setting up the interview in a particular kind of way that perhaps it wouldn't be set up in the mainstream media.
sentences.zh: 因为你以一种特殊的方式设定了采访基调，这种方式在主流媒体中可能不会这样设定。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Well, I'm glad you asked that, because I feel like part of our discussion before and today is getting at something that, like our wires are crossing.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我很高兴你问这个问题，因为我觉得我们之前和今天的讨论部分触及了一些东西，就像我们的频道对不上一样。

sentences.en: Your wires and my wires are crossing in a way.
sentences.zh: 你的频道和我的频道在某种程度上对不上。

sentences.en: Like you're kind of looking at me and saying, it's not behaving like a typical journaliSt.

sentences.en: And it is still calling itself a journaliSt.
sentences.zh: 而它仍然自称为记者。

sentences.zh: 我不是说你在评判我。

sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But I'm trying to say to you, yes, I'm still a journalist, but I'm in this new ecosystem where the old rules don't apply.
sentences.zh: 但我想对你说的是，是的，我仍然是一名记者，但我身处这个旧规则不再适用的新生态系统中。

sentences.en: You know, I'm in this world with, yes, Charlie Kirk and Dan Bongino and Ben Shapiro, but my world is also Joe Rogan and Theo Vaughn.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我身处这个世界，有查理·柯克、丹·邦吉诺和本·夏皮罗，但我的世界也包括乔·罗根和西奥·沃恩。

sentences.en: And it's a very large world,
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常广阔的世界，

sentences.en: and how the consumer receives it is by going on YouTube.com on their television screen or going to the vertical integrations on Instagram or TikTok and just taking in content.
sentences.zh: 消费者接收它的方式是通过电视屏幕上的YouTube.com，或者通过Instagram或TikTok上的垂直整合内容，直接获取内容。

sentences.en: What's the content that you want to receive?
sentences.zh: 你想接收什么样的内容？

sentences.en: I'm on the list of content creators, and so the fact that I'm also a journalist who breaks news and reports on news is like an extra.
sentences.zh: 我在内容创作者名单上，所以作为一个同时也打破新闻并报道新闻的记者，这就像是额外的东西。

sentences.en: But what's most important in my business now is authenticity.
sentences.zh: 但现在我的行业中最重要的是真实性。

sentences.zh: 你如何看待加州州长加文·纽森开始他的播客？

sentences.zh: 他请了查理·柯克作为他的第一位嘉宾。

sentences.en: He's basically saying, like, if you can't beat him, join him in not too many words, like we need to figure out a strategy.
sentences.zh: 他基本上是在说，如果你打不过他们，就加入他们，不用多说，我们需要想出一个策略。

sentences.en: What do you see about that strategy?
sentences.zh: 你对那个策略怎么看？

sentences.en: I think he's very smart to do it.
sentences.zh: 我认为他这样做非常聪明。

sentences.en: It's the right move.
sentences.zh: 这是正确的举动。

sentences.en: And he'll probably be pretty good at it because he's been a public speaker for a living.
sentences.zh: 而且他可能会做得很好，因为他以公开演讲为生。

sentences.en: And he could really benefit, as I think most people on the left could, from having his ideas tested.
sentences.zh: 而且他真的可以从中受益，就像我认为左派的大多数人一样，通过让他们的想法接受检验。

sentences.en: The right is very good at having these debates because they have to have them everywhere and they have for all of their lives.
sentences.zh: 右派非常擅长进行这些辩论，因为他们必须在任何地方进行辩论，而且他们一生都在这样做。

sentences.en: And the left is less good because they've just had their worldview reinforced over and over.
sentences.zh: 而左派不太擅长，因为他们的世界观只是被一次又一次地强化了。

sentences.en: And in this arena, it times 10, right?
sentences.zh: 在这个领域，这是十倍的难度，对吧？

sentences.en: Because that's all we do is debate all day, have people on, test our ideas, kick them around, get embarrassed, try to correct it, do better the next time.
sentences.zh: 因为我们整天做的就是辩论，请人来，检验我们的想法，反复推敲，感到尴尬，试着纠正它，下次做得更好。

sentences.en: Learn, grow, throw out yesterday's wrongness so you can be more right tomorrow, all that.
sentences.zh: 学习、成长、抛弃昨天的错误，这样你明天就能更正确，诸如此类。

sentences.en: So he's late to the party, but he's right to join it.
sentences.zh: 所以他加入得晚了，但他加入是对的。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: I think you're right that there is some way that we are discussing something different, right?
sentences.zh: 我想你是对的，我们在某种程度上讨论的是不同的东西，对吧？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I guess what I'm trying to understand is what are the rules of this new world that you are inhabiting?
sentences.zh: 我想我试图理解的是，你所居住的这个新世界的规则是什么？

sentences.en: Are you sort of making them up as you go along and you're seeing what it is?
sentences.zh: 你是边走边编，看看它是什么样子的吗？

sentences.en: Or do you adhere to some of those old values that you used to embrace?
sentences.zh: 还是你坚持你曾经拥抱的一些旧价值观？

sentences.en: The only way one succeeds in this medium is by violating all those rules that we used to have in journalism, where you don't really talk about yourself at all.
sentences.zh: 在这个媒介中取得成功的唯一方法，就是违反我们新闻业中曾经拥有的所有规则，即你根本不谈论你自己。

sentences.en: You don't talk about your opinions.
sentences.zh: 你不谈论你的观点。

sentences.en: You might have a bias.
sentences.zh: 你可能有偏见。

sentences.en: Your only goal is to hide it, not to own it and then get past it with the audience.
sentences.zh: 你唯一的目标是隐藏它，而不是承认它，然后与受众一起超越它。

sentences.en: It's just a whole new world.
sentences.zh: 这只是一个全新的世界。

sentences.en: And it's okay.
sentences.zh: 没关系。

sentences.en: Hey, we used to be much more partisan and openly partisan in our journalism and our media, you know, a hundred plus years ago, and we survived that just fine.
sentences.zh: 嘿，一百多年前，我们的新闻业和媒体党派色彩要浓厚得多，也公开得多，你知道，我们当时也安然无恙地挺过来了。

sentences.en: And we will survive this just fine, too.
sentences.zh: 我们现在也一样能安然度过。

sentences.en: What the audience wants from me is my authentic self and no filter.
sentences.zh: 观众从我这里想要的是真实的我，是不加滤镜的表达。

sentences.en: What they can smell from a mile away is a phony.
sentences.zh: 他们隔着老远就能闻出谁在装模作样。

sentences.en: So they have no problem with me endorsing Trump, even if they don't like Trump.
sentences.zh: 所以，即便他们不喜欢特朗普，也完全不介意我支持他。

sentences.en: What they would have a problem with is me pretending I don't have a horse in the race and going out and trying to deliver the news as though I'm completely objective and I'm just as open-minded to Kamala as I am to Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 他们真正在意的是，如果我假装自己立场中立，表现得好像我完全客观，对卡玛拉和唐纳德·特朗普一样开明，那才是他们无法接受的。

sentences.en: Were you ever approached to get into the Trump administration?
sentences.zh: 有没有人找过你，让你加入特朗普政府？

sentences.en: No comment.
sentences.zh: 无可奉告。

sentences.en: Well, let's just say I'm happy doing what I'm doing.
sentences.zh: 嗯，只能说我很享受现在做的事情。

sentences.en: What did they approach you for?
sentences.zh: 他们找你是因为什么？

sentences.en: Assumes facts, not in evidence.
sentences.zh: 这假设了未经证实的事实。

sentences.en: But look, if I thought I could be really helpful to the president, you know, it's not that I would never consider it.
sentences.zh: 但听着，如果我觉得自己真的能帮到总统，你知道，我并不是说我永远不会考虑。

sentences.en: But, Lulu, I finally have my life exactly as I want it, and I have no desire to upend it in any way right now.
sentences.zh: 但是，露露，我终于把生活过成了我想要的样子，现在我一点也不想打破这种平衡。
